evidence.text: "Reddish oak, in flower" and "Reddish ash tree, in flower."
"Purple anemone, in flower." An early-spring flower.
"You notice lengthening days." Days lengthen after midwinter, so this fits spring.
Young animals at the village and at the mound.
"Frost out of season." The game itself says frost is unusual now: a cold snap in spring.
Cracked mud and bare earth: a dry spell, or just turned fields?

next: Does the out-of-season frost matter (crops, the village's troubles)? Watch for it spreading.
